recipes.title: Styrian Soft Scrambled Eggs with Toasted Pumpkin Seed Oil
recipes.summary: Beloved Austrian breakfast classic of pillowy soft scrambled eggs finished off the stove with emerald toasted pumpkin seed oil and chives.
steps: Whisk eggs with 1 tbsp water and a pinch of salt.
Cook gently in olive oil over low heat, folding slowly 3 minutes until soft curds set.
Slide onto a warm plate beside toast and drizzle rich green toasted pumpkin seed oil, chives, and black pepper right over top.
tips: In Styria, Austria, finishing soft eggs (Eierspeise) with emerald pumpkin seed oil is an everyday favorite.
Always drizzle pumpkin seed oil off the burner so its delicate roasted-nut aroma stays bright.

recipes.title: Warm Cinnamon Pear Oatmeal with Pumpkin Seed Oil Swirl
recipes.summary: Creamy rolled oats cooked with diced ripe pear and cinnamon, finished with a fragrant nutty swirl of toasted pumpkin seed oil and pepitas.
steps: Simmer rolled oats, milk, diced pear, and cinnamon in a small saucepan for 6 to 7 minutes until soft and creamy.
Spoon into a warm bowl.
Swirl toasted pumpkin seed oil over the oats and sprinkle with toasted pumpkin seeds.
tips: Toasted pumpkin seed oil tastes deeply nutty—almost like toasted hazelnuts—and makes plain oats feel special.
A drizzle of maple syrup pairs wonderfully if you enjoy sweeter bowls.

recipes.title: Ricotta, Sliced Apple & Pumpkin Seed Oil Honey Toast
recipes.summary: Whole-grain toast spread with creamy ricotta, crisp sweet apple slices, a nutty ribbon of pumpkin seed oil, and warm honey.
steps: Toast whole-grain bread until warm and lightly crisp.
Spread ricotta evenly across both slices and fan thin apple slices on top.
Drizzle with toasted pumpkin seed oil and honey, and finish with a whisper of cinnamon.
tips: Great nut-free alternative to peanut butter toast with deep roasted flavor.
Store pumpkin seed oil in a cool dark cupboard or fridge so its deep green color stays vivid.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt, Maple & Pumpkin Seed Oil Parfait
recipes.summary: Creamy plain Greek yogurt swirled with toasted pumpkin seed oil and pure maple syrup, topped with raspberries and rolled oats.
steps: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl and drizzle toasted pumpkin seed oil and maple syrup across the top.
Give one light swirl with a spoon so ribbons of dark green oil streak the creamy yogurt.
Top with fresh raspberries and toasted oats.
tips: In Austria, vanilla ice cream drizzled with pumpkin seed oil is famous—this Greek yogurt version brings that rich contrast to breakfast.
Fresh blackberries or blueberries pair equally well.

recipes.title: Smashed Avocado, Cottage Cheese & Pumpkin Seed Oil Toast
recipes.summary: Savory whole-grain toast layered with whipped cottage cheese, sliced avocado, lemon juice, and toasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Spread cottage cheese generously onto warm toasted whole-grain bread.
Arrange ripe avocado slices over the cheese and squeeze fresh lemon juice on top.
Finish with a rich drizzle of toasted pumpkin seed oil and cracked black pepper.
tips: Avocado and toasted pumpkin seed oil share a velvety richness that feels remarkably satisfying.
Lightly mash the avocado with a fork first if you prefer a spread that won't slide off toast.

recipes.title: Austrian Butternut Squash Soup with Pumpkin Seed Oil Swirl
recipes.summary: Iconic golden pumpkin-squash soup simmered with apple and onion, blended velvety smooth and crowned with dark emerald toasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Simmer cubed squash, diced apple, onion, ginger, and vegetable broth in a pot for 16 to 18 minutes until fork-tender.
Blend completely smooth with an immersion blender and season lightly to taste.
Ladle into warm bowls and finish each with a generous spiral of toasted pumpkin seed oil and pepitas.
tips: Kurbiscremesuppe finished with dark green pumpkin seed oil is the signature soup of Styria.
Smooth pureed soup is effortless to swallow and freezes nicely for future lunches.

recipes.title: Roasted Beet, Apple & Pumpkin Seed Oil Vinaigrette Salad
recipes.summary: Earthy steamed beets, crisp apple, and leafy greens dressed in a tangy apple cider vinegar and toasted pumpkin seed oil vinaigrette.
steps: Shake toasted pumpkin seed oil, apple cider vinegar, and a pinch of salt and pepper in a jar until emulsified.
Toss baby spinach, diced beets, and apple slices gently in a salad bowl.
Drizzle with the nutty dressing and scatter goat cheese and pumpkin seeds over top.
tips: Apple cider vinegar and toasted pumpkin seed oil is the classic Central European salad dressing pair.
Pre-steamed grocery beets make this a 10-minute zero-cooking lunch.

recipes.title: Austrian Warm Potato, Cucumber & Pumpkin Seed Oil Salad
recipes.summary: Tender baby potatoes and thin crisp cucumber coins dressed warm in vegetable broth, cider vinegar, red onion, and dark toasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Boil sliced potatoes 12 to 14 minutes until tender; drain well and transfer to a bowl.
Toss warm potatoes with warm broth, apple cider vinegar, and finely diced red onion so they absorb the tangy seasoning.
Cool 2 minutes, then fold in sliced cucumber, toasted pumpkin seed oil, and chives.
tips: Warm broth creates a silky, mayo-free potato salad that stays bright and light.
Delicious at room temperature or gently chilled.

recipes.title: Creamy White Bean, Quinoa & Pumpkin Seed Oil Bowl
recipes.summary: Nourishing plant-based lunch bowl of cannellini beans, cooked quinoa, roasted carrots, and parsley finished in rich toasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Whisk toasted pumpkin seed oil, fresh lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper in a small bowl.
Arrange baby spinach, cooked quinoa, cannellini beans, and carrots into two bowls.
Drizzle generously with the emerald dressing and scatter with chopped parsley.
tips: Cannellini beans soak up nutty pumpkin seed oil cleanly without feeling heavy.
Grating carrots coarsely makes them soft and easy to chew in cold bowls.

recipes.title: Warm Green Lentil, Feta & Pumpkin Seed Oil Salad
recipes.summary: Savory warmed green lentils folded with diced sweet bell pepper, fresh parsley, tangy feta, and nutty cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil.

ingredient_details.item: finely diced sweet red bell pepper

steps: Warm cooked lentils gently with 2 tbsp water for 3 to 4 minutes, then transfer to a bowl.
Toss warm lentils with apple cider vinegar, diced bell pepper, parsley, and toasted pumpkin seed oil.
Finish with crumbled feta and cracked black pepper and serve warm or room temperature.
tips: Warm lentils release the roasted aroma of pumpkin seed oil the moment they touch.
Omit feta for a completely dairy-free lunch.

recipes.title: Creamy Barley & Butternut Squash Risotto with Pumpkin Seed Oil
recipes.summary: Cozy pearl barley simmered creamy with squash and Parmesan, plated with a striking dark green finish of toasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Simmer diced onion, squash cubes, quick pearl barley, thyme, and vegetable broth in a saucepan for 20 to 24 minutes, stirring occasionally until creamy and tender.
Remove from heat and stir in grated Parmesan cheese.
Ladle into warm shallow bowls and swirl toasted pumpkin seed oil across the top.
tips: Quick-cooking barley gives risotto-like creaminess without constant standing and stirring.
The deep roasted taste of pumpkin seed oil finishes the dish better than butter.

recipes.title: Alpine Baked Trout with Lemon & Pumpkin Seed Oil
recipes.summary: Delicate oven-baked trout fillets plated with boiled parsley potatoes and finished off-heat with nutty toasted pumpkin seed oil and lemon.
steps: Boil halved baby potatoes 12 minutes until fork-tender while baking lightly oiled trout fillets with black pepper at 400 F for 10 to 12 minutes.
Plate warm flaky trout alongside drained tender potatoes.
Drizzle both generously with lemon juice and cold-pressed toasted pumpkin seed oil, finishing with fresh parsley.
tips: Rainbow trout cooks quickly and flakes softly with minimal chewing.
Salmon or arctic char substitutes seamlessly if trout isn't at the fish counter.

recipes.title: Roasted Chicken & Sweet Root Vegetables with Pumpkin Seed Oil
recipes.summary: Sheet-pan roasted chicken thighs, carrots, and parsnips finished right before serving with a fragrant drizzle of toasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss chicken thighs, carrots, and parsnips with olive oil and thyme on a parchment-lined sheet pan.
Roast 22 to 25 minutes until chicken reaches 165 F and root vegetables are tender and caramelized.
Plate warm and drizzle with lemon juice and cold-pressed toasted pumpkin seed oil right before eating.
tips: Roast using heat-tolerant olive oil, then let raw toasted pumpkin seed oil perfume the finished dish.
Sweet potatoes work nicely in place of parsnips.

recipes.title: Spinach, Pepita & Pumpkin Seed Oil Pesto Pasta
recipes.summary: Nut-free vivid emerald pasta sauce blended from baby spinach, parsley, toasted pepitas, garlic, and cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Cook short pasta according to package instructions, saving 1/3 cup starchy cooking water.
Blend baby spinach, parsley, toasted pumpkin seeds, garlic, lemon juice, and toasted pumpkin seed oil into a creamy deep-green pesto.
Toss warm drained pasta off the stove with the pesto and splashes of cooking water until glossy.
tips: 100% nut-free and dairy-free while tasting deeply savory and rich.
Fold in cooked white beans or peas for extra dinner protein.

recipes.title: Garlic Mushrooms over Velvety Pumpkin Seed Oil Mash
recipes.summary: Soft cauliflower-potato mash enriched off-heat with toasted pumpkin seed oil and crowned with thyme-sauteed cremini mushrooms.
steps: Boil cauliflower florets and cubed potato 12 minutes until fork-tender, then drain and mash smooth with 1 tbsp toasted pumpkin seed oil and a splash of hot water.
Meanwhile saute sliced mushrooms in olive oil 6 minutes until browned, adding garlic and thyme for the last minute.
Spoon mushrooms over bowls of creamy mash and finish with the remaining 1 tbsp toasted pumpkin seed oil.
tips: Blending cauliflower with one Yukon Gold potato gives light texture with buttery potato comfort.
Very soft and easy to spoon for calm evening dining.

recipes.title: Velvet Pumpkin Puree, Banana & Pumpkin Seed Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Cozy autumn-spiced smoothie blending real pumpkin puree, frozen banana, oat milk, cinnamon, and nutty toasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Combine oat milk, pumpkin puree, frozen banana, cinnamon, maple syrup, and toasted pumpkin seed oil in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until thick, velvety, and warmly spiced.
Pour into a glass and enjoy right away.
tips: Toasted pumpkin seed oil gives this smoothie a roasted pecan-pie warmth without any tree nuts.
Great way to boost healthy unsaturated fats alongside beta-carotene-rich pumpkin.

recipes.title: Baked-Apple Style Oat & Pumpkin Seed Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Creamy apple-pie inspired breakfast glass blending crisp apple, rolled oats, Greek yogurt, cinnamon, and roasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Add milk, Greek yogurt, diced apple, rolled oats, cinnamon, toasted pumpkin seed oil, and 4 ice cubes to a blender.
Blend on high 60 seconds until completely silky.
Pour into a tall glass and sip cold.
tips: Peel the apple first if you prefer the smoothest possible consistency.
Add 1 pitted date for extra caramel sweetness.

recipes.title: Deep Berry, Spinach & Pumpkin Seed Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Antioxidant-rich purple-green blend of frozen blueberries, baby spinach, banana, almond milk, and toasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Blend almond milk and baby spinach 20 seconds until bright green and smooth.
Add frozen blueberries, ripe banana, and toasted pumpkin seed oil.
Blend another 35 seconds until thick and velvety.
tips: Healthy seed oil helps your body absorb fat-soluble nutrients from the leafy spinach.
Oat milk keeps this glass 100% nut-free.

recipes.title: Styrian Vanilla Bean, Pear & Pumpkin Seed Oil Shake
recipes.summary: Inspired by Austrian vanilla-and-pumpkin-seed-oil gelato: ripe pear, Greek yogurt, milk, vanilla, and toasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Combine milk, Greek yogurt, peeled pear, vanilla extract, toasted pumpkin seed oil, and ice in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until pale sage-green, creamy, and lightly frothy.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Vanilla and toasted pumpkin seed oil is one of Europe's hidden culinary gems.
Save a drop of the dark emerald oil to drizzle right on top of the foam.

recipes.title: Toasted Cocoa, Date & Pumpkin Seed Oil Velvet Smoothie
recipes.summary: Rich nut-free chocolate-hazelnut-style smoothie combining cocoa powder, Medjool date, frozen banana, oat milk, and toasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Place oat milk, frozen banana, cocoa powder, pitted date, and toasted pumpkin seed oil in a blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until thick, glossy, and completely smooth.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy.
tips: Roasted pumpkin seed oil mimics toasted hazelnut notes alongside cocoa—completely tree-nut-free.
Add a tiny pinch of cinnamon for extra warmth.

recipes.title: Golden Carrot, Apple & Pumpkin Seed Oil Orchard Press
recipes.summary: Sweet pressed carrot and apple juice brightened with ginger and shaken smooth with a nutty teaspoon of cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Combine carrot juice, apple juice, ginger juice, lemon juice, and toasted pumpkin seed oil in a jar.
Shake vigorously for 10 seconds to emulsify smoothly.
Pour into a chilled glass and sip immediately.
tips: Pumpkin seed oil's rich nutty finish complements sweet carrots while boosting beta-carotene absorption.
Use crisp Styrian-style unfiltered apple juice if available.

recipes.title: Crimson Beet, Orange & Pumpkin Seed Oil Press
recipes.summary: Earthy beet juice and bright sweet orange juice shaken briskly with cold-pressed toasted pumpkin seed oil for a smooth, nutty tonic.
steps: Add beet juice, freshly squeezed orange juice, lemon juice, and toasted pumpkin seed oil to a lidded jar.
Shake briskly 10 seconds until emulsified.
Pour over ice cubes and serve right away.
tips: Beets and toasted pumpkin seed oil are a classic pairing—refreshing in juice form too.
Rinse glasses promptly to avoid beet staining.

recipes.title: Savory Tomato, Carrot & Pumpkin Seed Oil Harvest Press
recipes.summary: Rich savory vegetable juice pairing low-sodium tomato and carrot juices with cider vinegar, black pepper, and toasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Pour tomato juice, carrot juice, apple cider vinegar, black pepper, and toasted pumpkin seed oil into a jar.
Shake well for 10 seconds until unified and smooth.
Serve chilled over two ice cubes.
tips: Tastes like a crisp chilled harvest vegetable soup in a glass.
Healthy plant fats help absorb both tomato lycopene and carrot beta-carotene.

recipes.title: Crisp Pear, Lemon & Pumpkin Seed Oil Garden Cooler
recipes.summary: Gentle sweet pear nectar brightened with fresh lemon juice, cool water, spearmint, and a velvety shaken teaspoon of pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Shake pure pear juice, cold water, lemon juice, and toasted pumpkin seed oil briskly in a lidded jar for 10 seconds.
Pour over ice into a chilled glass.
Garnish with fresh spearmint leaves and sip right away.
tips: Mild pear juice lets the roasted, hazelnut-like perfume of Styrian pumpkin seed oil shine gently.
Choose 100% pressed pear juice with no added sugar.

recipes.title: Orange, Pineapple & Pumpkin Seed Oil Golden Press
recipes.summary: Sunny citrus-pineapple tonic whisked smooth with warm turmeric and a rich teaspoon of toasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Combine orange juice, pineapple juice, turmeric, black pepper, and toasted pumpkin seed oil in a jar.
Shake briskly 15 seconds until vibrant golden and evenly suspended.
Serve cold over ice right away.
tips: Bright sweet citrus balances earthy turmeric while pumpkin seed oil supports fat-soluble absorption.
Shake gently once more if it sits for a few minutes.
